name: Xtari I
author: Komatic5
description: Move to the floor as the ball before the blue pad at 25%. Time a click shortly after the percentage bar changes to 26% and then click once after passing the dash orb to enter the wave portal as mini. Navigate through the structures as the mini wave until 27% where you can hold to the ceiling between the structures right before the robot portal. Drop down at 28%, touch the reverse gravity portal and then hold to the floor until 33%. Free to the end from there.
